items.title: Natty Dominique Interview, 1958-05-31
items.q: Another boy I worked with in New Orleans too, he's in that nice pal, but I don't know if he played with Walter Decker.

ctx.x: I never heard him play much piano solos. Was he good on piano?

Very good on solos. Moneyy Jones could play some nice solos with him. Very good. He composed a lot of numbers. And he'd write it too. A lot of people didn't think Moneyy Jones knew music. But he'd write out that music. Moneyy Jones. I'm not going to down him. Another boy I worked with in New Orleans too, he's in that nice pal, but I don't know if he played with Walter Decker.
Oh no. He's still living. Still living.
